rows.my_view: Skeptical of hype, asking what would have to happen to justify a $17B valuation.
rows.committee: Expensive at 92x sales — the price already assumes IonQ wins the science race and 10x's revenue, so we agree there is no margin of safety.

rows.my_view: The +755% Q1 jump may be real adoption or just pilots, grants, and acquired hardware.
rows.committee: Growth is dazzling but its organic-vs-acquired quality is a black box until the 2026-08-04 print, so the number cannot yet be trusted as adoption.

rows.my_view: Commercialization realism is unproven and worth probing.
rows.committee: Gross margin fell 63% to 40% to 24% — the opposite of a scaling platform — and whether this is temporary hardware mix or structural erosion is the decisive open question.

rows.my_view: Do not assume durability; test it against big-tech and pure-play rivals.
rows.committee: Unproven — distribution is rented from Amazon, Microsoft, and Google who build their own hardware, switching costs are near-zero, and the whole moat hinges on trapped-ion winning an unresolved architecture race.

rows.my_view: Scrutinize dilution and capital needs as a survival risk.
rows.committee: Shares rose 280M to 373M — roughly $4B issued against only $300M of burn — which reads as opportunistic high-multiple M&A currency, less desperate than a bleed but only viable while the multiple stays inflated.

rows.my_view: Timeline risk — hype without adoption if commercialization is a decade out.
rows.committee: We agree the killer is timing: ~$425M annual burn and dilution happen now while the payoff is distant and unproven, so you can be right on IonQ and wrong on IONQ.

rows.my_view: Treated the '$463M net cash' figure and dilution largely as a survival threat.
rows.committee: The $463M figure is an arithmetic error — $2.03B cash minus $30.4M debt is ~$2.0B net cash and ~5 years of runway — and the real trap you missed is the warrant accounting, where a stock decline triggers a GAAP 'loss' that reflexively feeds more selling.
The 2026-08-04 Q2 print — specifically gross-margin direction and the organic-vs-acquired revenue mix — resolves margin, growth quality, share count, and cash in a single disclosure.

confidence.label: High
confidence.why: The skeptical brief and the evidence-based house view converge on every weighted dimension, and the decisive disclosure is a known date one month away.

final_verdict: Narrative-priced speculation with real runway but no proven adoption — correctly a watchlist bet whose fate hinges entirely on the next earnings print.
